data.one_liner: A customizable floating action button menu that pops up small FABs on top.
data.what_it_does: Provides a floating action button widget that expands into a menu containing multiple smaller secondary floating action buttons when pressed. Allows customization of colors, icons, background blur, and can toggle the menu open state manually.
use_when: You need a quick floating menu attached to a floating action button in your app.
You want to display multiple secondary actions cleanly from a single FAB.
avoid_when: You need complex navigation drawers or bottom sheets instead of a FAB expansion.
You require a non-Material UI paradigm.
strengths: Easy to customize colors, icons, and backgrounds.
Supports toggling the menu open state manually.
Includes built-in blur effect for the background.
weaknesses: Limited to a specific floating action button menu style.
Not documented for advanced layouts beyond basic popups.
data.minimal_example:
HawkFabMenu(
  icon: AnimatedIcons.menu_arrow,
  fabColor: Colors.blue,
  items: [
    HawkFabMenuChild(
      icon: Icons.person,
      label: 'Profile',
      onTap: () => print('Profile selected'),
    ),
  ],
  body: Center(child: Text('Hello World')),
)
